Unique Charms
(See Normal Charms)

Annihilus*
Small Charm

 		Required Level: 70
+1 To All Skills
+10-20 To All Attributes (varies)
All Resistances +10-20 (varies)
+5-10% To Experience Gained (varies)
(Only Spawns In Patch 1.10 or later)
Gheed's Fortune*
Grand Charm

 		Required Level: 62
80-160% Extra Gold From Monsters (varies)
Reduces All Vendor Prices 10-15% (varies)
20-40% Better Chance of Getting Magic Items (varies)
(Ladder Only)
(Only Spawns In Patch 1.10 or later)
Hellfire Torch*
Large Charm

 		Required Level: 75
5% Chance To Cast level 10 Firestorm* On Striking
+3 to Random Character Class Skills (varies)
+10-20 To All Attributes (varies)
All Resistances +10-20 (varies)
+8 To Light Radius
Level 30 Hydra (10 charges)
(Only Spawns In Patch 1.13 or later)
Notes:

-You can only have one of these (each) Charms in your possession (backpack/cube/stash) at a time. If you already have one of the Charms you cannot pick up a second one of the same type. This is to discourage trading/stockpiling =]
Annihilus - This item is only dropped from Über Diablo on the Battle.net Realms. It is only available on the Realms.
Gheed's Fortune - You can only have one Gheed's Fortune Charm in your inventory at a time. Note: (Single Player, Ladder Only). Gheed's Fortune exists on non-ladder because of past Ladder resets.
Hellfire Torch - You can only have one charm. Only spawns via doing a secret Pandemonium event. Firestorm is Diablo's Special Firestorm attack. The random character class skills are NOT based on the class played.
